language_task: Seperate the food and the toys into the two bowls.
outcome_evidence: The robot sorts the brown food-shaped object, carrot and orange into the green bowl, and the blue and pink animal toys into the purple bowl. wrist_cam shows both toys together at frame 443 and all three food objects together at frames 737–739; overhead_cam confirms the cleared tabletop and occupied bowls through frame 752. All acquisitions and placements succeed, but the carrot transfer includes a large excursion away from the bowls before returning (frames 549–608, overhead_cam and wrist_cam).

failure_annotations.explanation: While securely holding the carrot, the robot moves outward and high away from the nearby green bowl rather than progressing toward placement (overhead_cam, frames 549–580). wrist_cam shows the tabletop giving way to views of the surrounding room while the carrot remains held (frames 560–587). This extended transfer detour is unproductive; the subsequent return toward the table leads to successful placement at frames 619–623. No hidden cause is established.
failure_annotations.recovery: Bring the held carrot back along a clear, controlled path, align above the green bowl and lower it for release; human intervention is not needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The carrot remains held throughout the excursion, with no visible collision, damage or dropped object in either camera.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The bowls and other objects remain in valid positions and the carrot is still grasped, so placement can resume without environmental resetting or human intervention.
